candidates.trace: The quest validator admits plausibility and curation independently from 0 through u32::MAX and enforces zero-reason and identity checks; Weight::combined widens their product to u64. select_follow_up_evidence selects a contextual weight per baseline evidence identity, filters impossible or zero candidates, canonicalizes IDs, and calls the shared weighted_index with expect. The pinned Rand 0.9.5 WeightedIndex implementation adds u64 weights with checked addition and returns Overflow; the wrapper maps this to SamplingError::WeightOverflow, so expect would panic for an overflowing nonempty vector. Normal quest choose and weighted_order propagate SamplingError instead; all-zero follow-up candidates return None before sampling.
candidates.source_derived_example: As a hypothetical content change, keep evidence.trackable_ground/footprints and add existing evidence identity cloth_scrap there, giving both plausibility and curation u32::MAX with no hard-zero reason or bridge. Each product is 18446744065119617025, representable in u64, but their sum is 36893488130239234050, greater than u64::MAX 18446744073709551615. These values pass the selected per-candidate numeric and zero-reason checks; no product validator or edited content was run, so whole-corpus acceptance is not asserted.
candidates.conditional_context: The checked-in recurring-depredation catalogue has a positive skeleton cause and a positive crypt site. If a valid generated case selects that cause and crypt as its true site, initial evidence selection does not choose the trackable-ground relation for the crypt. The assembler separately creates a roadside evidence site. If the later generated-incident draw selects that roadside site, the two changed contextual weights are selected and the pinned sampler reaches the checked overflow. No seed, generated manifest, incident, transaction, server panic or runtime reachability was exercised or proved; other generation gates and supported content policy remain open.
candidates.current_corpus: Read-only JSON inspection finds seven baseline evidence identities. Summing, for each baseline identity, the largest product across baseline and the four contextual evidence relations used by evidence_candidates gives an over-approximation of 26950, far below u64::MAX. This proves only that these selected current authored relation values cannot overflow that sum under any combination of the inspected contextual choices; it does not resolve other samplers or future authored inputs.
candidates.native_boundary: The generated-incident updater selects a sorted generated site and calls the follow-up selector before the selected incident event/evidence inserts. Native identity, persisted manifest and chronological gates remain separate; this trace makes no transaction rollback or player-impact assertion.
